System

Equipment slots, two-hand conflicts and paper-doll visuals

Equip valid items into logical stat slots independently of sprite layer coverage. Chest and Top are one slot; Legs and Pants are one slot. A combined outfit sheet cannot be split into independent chest/leg images merely by creating gameplay slots.

Scope and player interaction

Equip valid items into logical stat slots independently of sprite layer coverage. Chest and Top are one slot; Legs and Pants are one slot. A combined outfit sheet cannot be split into independent chest/leg images merely by creating gameplay slots.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase09committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Ready → EquipPending → Conflict → RequirementsFailed → VisualFallback → UnequipPending

WBP_Equipment observes results from URPGEquipmentComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_EquipmentRules_Default. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
Slot enum: Head, Chest, Legs, Hands, Feet, Waist, Shoulders, Cloak, MainHand, OffHand, Neck, Ring1, Ring2, Trinket1, Trinket2
EquippedItemIds: map logical slot -> owned UUID; persisted and revisioned
WeaponHandPolicy: OneHand|TwoHand|OffHandOnly; shield subtype validated
VisualCoverage: stats-only|independent layer|combined outfit|missing; per definition/action/page
AppearanceRevision: replicated public snapshot, not inventory detail
EquipmentSetId and thresholds: authored stat rules; recompute once per build revision

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGEquipmentComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_EquipmentLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
RequestEquip(CommandId, OwnedItemId, DestinationSlot, ExpectedRevision) -> Equipped|RequirementsFailed|EquipmentConflict|NoSpace
RequestUnequip(CommandId, Slot, ExpectedItemId) -> Unequipped|NoSpace|StaleItem
ResolveEquipmentVisuals(EquippedSnapshot, ActionPage) -> LayerSet|Fallback; cosmetic only
RebuildEquipmentModifiers(EquipmentRevision) -> AttributesUpdated; server

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Player selects owned gear and slot; UI previews compatibility but sends item identity rather than claimed stat bonuses.
  2. Backend validates ownership, class/level, slot type, binding and equipment state under the current session/revision.
  3. For a two-handed weapon, plan removal of OffHand and any replaced MainHand into the bag before commit. Reject NoSpace when displaced gear cannot fit; do not delete or silently drop it.
  4. Commit bag/equipment/binding changes and build revision together. Recompute equipment/set modifiers without accumulating duplicates.
  5. Replicate safe visual definition IDs and appearance revision to nearby clients; owner sees full stat/item details.
  6. Paper-doll resolver selects compatible action-page layers. Missing shoulder/boot/glove/chest coverage displays fallback or no overlay while valid stat bonuses remain applied.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create the 15-position enum and DA_EquipmentRules_Default; add aliases only at import/UI boundary, never duplicate Chest/Top or Legs/Pants slots in persistence.
  2. Build WBP_Equipment with all logical positions and clear stats-only indicators. Two rings/trinkets have distinct slot IDs even when visually similar.
  3. Create sword/shield/two-hand test definitions and a combined-outfit visual mapping. Add equipment component to PlayerState and appearance observer to BP_PlayerCharacter.
  4. Reopen URPGInventoryComponent capacity planning and URPGProgressionComponent/GAS modifier rebuild to consume committed equipment changes.
  5. Reopen DA_AnimationSet_Common and art visual matrix; explicitly record which equipped definitions replace an outfit preset, hide a layer or have no supported overlay.

Reopen Phase09 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / Sword_A / Shield_A / Greatblade_A / WovenCloak_A. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Equip two-hand weapon with full bag and shield equipped -> NoSpace, both current slots unchanged.
Equip shield while two-hand main weapon remains -> EquipmentConflict under initial no-auto-swap policy.
Missing visual layer -> VisualFallback warning only; stats stay active.
Sell equipped item -> reject until valid unequip or one explicitly atomic sell policy; no orphan equipment pointer.
Repeated equip/reconnect -> one modifier set and visually consistent remote avatar.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Shoulders are stats-only until art exists. Neck/rings/trinkets may remain stats-only permanently. Default equipment does not make all armor independently visible; visual compatibility is a separate production contract.

Debug screen shows logical slot, UUID, definition, modifiers, active animation page and visual fallback. Screen reader labels include slot and requirements; no tiny-only drag targets.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
